d: Following their first duet performance since 1960's by Pandit Shivkumar Sharma (Santoor) and Pandit Hariprasad Chaurasia (Bansuri) at Mumbai's Nehru Centre in Dec 1995 (concert released on Navras Records Catalogue under the title "The Valley Recalls"), the duo were presented for their first ever duet in London in Oct 1997. The Navras Records / Sama Arts concert was presented at London's Royal Festival Hall.
